|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Ello Asty (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V8-L-elloasty-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-elloasty022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/elloasty.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/elloasty.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Sic-Six”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting an X-wing alone, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and all immunity to attrition here is canceled. Once during your control phase, may take Sabotage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ello Asty (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-elloasty6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/elloasty.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/elloasty.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Sic-Six”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting an X-wing alone, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and all immunity to attrition here is canceled. Once during your control phase, may take Sabotage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
